description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git blame' in various corner cases, including file operations, merge conflicts, line range options, attribute handling, and coalescing behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and reports if the test passes.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a test file.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the Git test clock to timestamp commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test finishes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the command it runs fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file or input.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file or output.
